Heh, it seems our summer adventure is going to end

Heh, summer break has only just begun.

Hmm…… apparently they couldn't determine

Well, it's no problem if they leave.
Let's continue securing the coastline.

Come now, don't be so down.

Another dubious entity appears…

Now that everyone is trudging back up the shore,

Everyone seems to be fully prepared for some fun!
Then let's not waste any time and go for a swim!

Hmph…… so you are the Kingdom and Empire armies.

It's a major incident whether we like it or not……!
Anyway, let's defeat the slimes that are emerging!

This is bad, Doctor! That First Emperor

Have you perhaps invented anything

A summer vacation drenched in slime.
If I were to give this event a title, it would be this――
m200570.スライム化やらで被害にあった海の魔物たちに、\nしっかり補填をしてから行方をくら:
It appears they made proper compensation to the sea monsters
who were affected by the sliming before disappearing.
m200570.スライム増産装置によるスライム化は、\n今までリミッターによる制限のおかげで、\:
The slime-ification caused by the Slime Mass Production Device
has been confined to the seas near the Empire
thanks to the restrictions imposed by the limiter.
m200570.ド派手っていうより阿鼻叫喚じゃないかな？: “Spectacle”? I'd call it a total bloodbath.
m200570.ローパー博士のことは王子殿と相談するとして、\nそれより今はスライム増産装置だ。:
Let's discuss Dr. Rooper with the Prince later.
Right now, we need to focus on the Slime Mass Production Device.
m200570.ローパー博士の発明品は、\n思っていたよりも高性能だったってことなのかな。: I suppose Professor Loper's invention was more powerful than we expected.
m200570.ローパー博士はボコボコになってもらうとして。\n海の魔物たちのためにも、\n早く: Assuming Dr. Rooper gets a thorough beating, we should try to resolve this as soon as possible for the sake of the sea monsters.
m200570.ローパー博士を野放しにすると、\n絶対ろくなことにならないと思うけど……。\n彼:
If we leave Dr. Looper to his own devices,
it absolutely won't end well……
I'll leave the decision on them to the Prince.
m200570.久しぶりの海でテンションが上がってるね。\nまぁ、それは私たちも同じだけど。:
You're quite excited about the beach after being away from it for so long.
Well, we're feeling the same way, though.
m200570.今の帝国は変革期だ。\n良くも悪くも変わっていくということかもしれないね。:
The Empire is in a period of transformation.
For better or worse, things are changing, it seems.
m200570.今回はこういう人たちばっかりだから、\n早く海での遊びに切り替えたいなぁ……！:
With this bunch here,
I really want to switch over to some beach fun already……!
m200570.他にやることがあるんだし、\nこいつらはさっさと倒すわよ！:
We have other things to do, so
let's take these guys down quickly!
m200570.元々はスライム化した水を制御するための機能でしたが、\n暴走により外敵排除に使わ:
It was originally a function for controlling the slime-ified water,
but it appears to be repurposed for eliminating external threats due to the malfunction.
m200570.元凶ですか……。\nそれで、その不審人物とやらは何者なんです？:
The culprit……
And who is this suspicious figure, exactly?
m200570.先に解決しなければならない問題が発生したようですね。: It appears we have a more pressing issue to deal with first.
m200570.分かりきっていたことだけれど、\n大人しく始末されるつもりはないみたいね。:
I knew it, but it seems
they have no intention of going down quietly.

It's a bit too big to share out as is,
so I'll cut it into slices so it's easy for everyone to eat♪
m200570.勢いで攻撃しちゃったけど、\nこの魔物たちってもしかして、\nスライム化の被害者:
I attacked on a whim, but
could these monsters actually be
victims of the slime transformation……?
m200570.合同演習にはそこまでそそられませんが……。\n水着姿の美女がこうも揃うと、さすが: I'm not particularly drawn to joint exercises, but…… seeing so many beautiful women in swimsuits is quite the sight.

I have no intention of harming you.
Given the circumstances, I will ask for your help in cleaning up the mess as a form of punishment, but
I am not thinking of taking your life.
m200570.君はいつまで拗ねてるんだい。: How long are you going to keep sulking?

As a bard, I find such an ending rather unsatisfying,
but I am one who tells the true history.
I shall make sure to immortalize this explosion in verse.
m200570.問題はどうやって水着スライムとやらを\n捜索するかですが――:
The problem is how we go about searching
for this so-called Swimsuit Slime――

m200570.夏季休暇を利用した、\n王国と帝国による合同演習ですか。: A joint exercise between the Kingdom and the Empire, held during the summer vacation, is it?

I've failed plenty of experiments in my time,

I'm completely at a loss.

How the Empire will change going forward.
It is certainly very interesting, but…….

The Empire's forces are here too.

m200570.復活してからはじめての海だったのですがね……。: It was supposed to be my first time at the sea since my revival……

My apologies. And so, Dr. Rooper.

is my assessment correct?

Dr. Rooper: We were unable to locate her ourselves,

So we've found the slime we were looking for.

Wearing a swimsuit really backfired.

Excuse me, swimsuit slime.

There's no sign of reinforcements coming from the sea.

For the sea to end up like this…

To get straight to the point,

There's absolutely no way we should be playing in the sea right now.

I don't think your wish to enjoy the sea is

m200570.貴様らを倒して、安寧の海を手に入れるとしよう。: We will defeat you and reclaim a peaceful sea.

I'm wearing a hat, after all.

Indeed. Our frontline units, who can withstand attacks,
will need to pin Dun down and keep his attention.
m900336.神獣ドゥンの加護を受けていると思うと、\nなかなか心強い装備なんじゃないかな？:
Knowing that you have the Divine Beast Dun's protection
makes it a pretty reassuring piece of equipment, don't you think?
m900336.神獣ドゥンの武具をまとう時には、\n称号を「雷虎を征す者」にすればいいからねー。:
When you equip the Divine Beast Dun's gear,
you can set your title to "Conqueror of the Thunder Tiger," you know~.
m900336.神獣ドゥンは、千年戦争当時に、\n魔王に対抗するため、\n天界から派遣されたとい:
The Divine Beast Dun is a powerful creature that,
during the Millennium War,
was said to have been dispatched from the heavens to oppose the Demon King.
m900336.貫禄抜群ねぇ……。\n本当は捕獲して、研究したいところだけど――:
He's got quite the presence……
I'd really love to capture him for research, but――

m920005.……もうあまり時間がございません。\n王子、共に参りましょう！: …We don't have much time left. Prince, let's go together!
m920005.ああ、追手がそこまで……\nもう逃げ切れない……: Ah, the pursuers have caught up... There's no way we can escape now...
m920005.あの小屋を目指しているようですね。\n何かあるのでしょうか？: They seem to be heading for that hut. I wonder what's there.
m920005.あの方は！\nああ…女神様の導きに感謝いたします。: That one! …Ah… I thank the goddess for her guidance.
m920005.あれは！竜人の兵士のようです。\nまだ生き残りが地上にいたのでしょうか。: Look! Those must be dragonfolk soldiers. There must still be survivors on the surface.
m920005.だからどうか王子、\n私に力を貸してはいただけないでしょうか……！\nもちろん案: So, Prince, could you lend me your aid? Of course, I'll be your guide.
m920005.ですが竜人の中にも、私のように人間と共存したい\n同志はいます！: But there are among us, like myself, who want to coexist with humans!
m920005.どうやら小屋の中に誰か隠れているようです。\n竜人たちは誰を追っていたのでしょう: Someone's hiding inside the hut. Who were the dragonfolk after?
m920005.むしろ今の私たちは、平和に人間の方たちと共存したいと\n願っているんです……。: In fact, we now wish to live in peace alongside humans...
m920005.今回、大長老が再び人間との戦いの命を下したとき、\n思わず私は地下から逃げ出して: When the High Elder once again ordered a war against humanity, I couldn't help but flee from the underground.
m920005.今地上では、各方面で一族たちが侵攻を進めています。\nまずはそこから食い止めなく: Right now, our clan is advancing on all fronts across the surface. We have to stop them first!
m920005.以前、私たち一族と戦われたことは存じております。\nですが、人間と私たちがいがみ: I know you've fought our clan before, but the enmity between humans and us dates back to a time long past.
m920005.助けていただいて、本当にありがとうございます。\n改めまして、私は竜人の巫女でエ: Thank you so much for rescuing me. Allow me to introduce myself properly—I'm Echidna, a priestess of the dragonfolk.
m920005.大長老は、私たち竜人一族の頂点に立つお方でございます。\nその方の命令には、誰も: The High Elder stands at the very top of our dragonfolk lineage. No one can defy his commands...
m920005.昔の人間との戦争を経験しているお方でもありますから、\nいまだ人間に恨みをお持ち: He's even lived through the ancient wars with humans, so he still bears a grudge against them.

m920032.……だが、それはあくまで目にかなえばの話だ。\n私の与える課題を乗り越えることが:
…but that's only if you meet my expectations.
If you can overcome the challenges I set, I'll acknowledge you as my lord.
m920032.ここから先は私も本気で戦わせてもらう。: From here on, I'll fight you seriously, too.
m920032.ここでは騎馬弓兵と戦ってもらう。\nだが、アーマーを出撃させることは禁止だ。:
Here, you'll face mounted archers.
However, deploying armor is prohibited.
m920032.この力は、私が認めた者の為に使いたい。\nこれからよろしく頼む、王子。:
I want to use this power for those I deem worthy.
From now on, I count on you, Prince.
m920032.さすが女神アイギスに選ばれたことはあるな……。\nこれまで目にした勇者の中でも群:
As expected of someone chosen by the goddess Aegis…
Your strength surpasses any hero I've seen.
m920032.だが、ただで協力するというわけにはいかない。\nその前にあなたの力がどれほどのも:
But I won't cooperate for free.
First, I want to see with my own eyes just how powerful you are.
m920032.だが足の速い騎馬部隊を近距離の兵士で\n止めることができないならどう戦う！: But if you can't stop fast cavalry with close-range troops, how will you fight!
m920032.なるほど……。\nこれ位はなんてことはないか。:
I see…
This is nothing special.
m920032.まさかここまでとは……。\nあなたの強さを認めざるを得ないようだ。:
I never expected it to go this far…
I have no choice but to acknowledge your strength.
m920032.今度は重装備の騎兵部隊が相手をする。\nただし回復することは禁止だ。:
Next, you'll face heavily armored cavalry.
But healing is forbidden.
m920032.先ほどと同じと思って侮らないことだな。: Don't underestimate it thinking it's the same as before.
m920032.先ほどは自己紹介もなく失礼した。\n改めて、私の名はエミリア。\n神の啓示を受け:
Sorry for not introducing myself earlier.
Allow me to start over: my name is Emilia.
I have come this far by divine revelation.
m920032.報告！ 砂漠に多数の騎兵部隊が\n出現しているもよう！: Report! A large cavalry force has appeared in the desert!
m920032.報告！ 魔物による襲撃です！ \nその数多数！:
Report! We're under monster attack!
They're swarming in large numbers!
m920032.女神アイギスに選ばれし王子とは\nあなたで間違いはないようだ。: It seems you are indeed the prince chosen by the goddess Aegis.
m920032.女神アイギスに選ばれたという\n王子の力を見極めに来た。: I've come to assess the prince chosen by the goddess Aegis.
m920032.戦乙女として数々の勇者を見てきた。\n私の目にかなう程の強者ならば\nあなたに仕:
As a war maiden, I've witnessed countless heroes.
If you're strong enough to meet my standards,
I'll serve you.
m920032.王子、向かってきます。\n迎え撃つしかないようです。:
Prince, they're coming.
It looks like we have no choice but to intercept.
m920032.王子、急ぎ迎え撃ちましょう！: Prince, let's rush to meet them!
m920032.砂漠で戦うとなると、兵士の体力が心配です。\nなにせ灼熱の地……。 \n王:
Fighting in the desert worries the soldiers' stamina.
After all, it's a scorching land…
Prince, please watch their endurance carefully.
m920032.私の騎馬部隊を相手にこれ程とは……。\nなかなかのやり手というわけか。:
Facing my cavalry to this extent…
You're quite the capable opponent.
m920032.私も魔物を倒すのを目的としている。\n故に同じ目的を有する王子に敵対する理由はな:
I, too, aim to slay monsters.
Therefore I have no reason to oppose a prince who shares that goal.
On the contrary, I'm willing to cooperate.
m920032.約束だ。\n最初に言った通り、王子に協力しよう。:
It's a promise.
As I said at the start, I'll cooperate with you, Prince.
m920032.近距離同士の真っ向勝負と\nいかせていただこう……！: Let's settle this with a close-quarters, head-on clash...!
m920032.通常、弓の攻撃は大盾と鎧で受けるのが有効……。\nしかしそれを封じた時、果たして:
Normally, a big shield and armor are effective against arrows…
But when that's taken away, let's see if you can still fight.
m920032.選ばれし王子、英雄の末裔……、\nどうやら肩書きだけではないらしい。:
Chosen prince, descendant of heroes…
It appears those titles aren't just for show.
m920032.防御の高い重装騎兵を相手に、\nどこまで耐える事ができるか見せてもらう。: Against high-defense heavy cavalry, show me how much you can endure.

m920210.――あなたを、仮死にしてあげる。: —I shall put you into a state of suspended animation.
m920210.――ってやつ、言ってみたかったんだ。: ――That's the line I wanted to say.
m920210.――なんだとッ！？\nもう一度言ってみろ！:
What did you say?!
Say that again!
m920210.――はッ！？ ここはいったい……？\nそうだ、私の妻と娘と母とママが昏睡状態で！:
Hah?! Where am I…?
That's right! My wife, my daughter, and my mother are in a coma!
m920210.――ふぅ。どうやら片付いたみたいね。\nどう？ 女の子は目覚めた？:
Phew. Looks like we're done here.
Did the girl wake up?
m920210.――ほう、いいだろう。\n貴様らは顎を砕かれても「まずい」と言えるのか？:
――Hmph, very well.
Can you still say it's "terrible" with your jaw broken?
m920210.――ワルツに手を出すな、災厄の魔女スィーテン。: —Don't lay a hand on Waltz, you witch of calamity, Suiten.
m920210.――伝令ですッ！\n王都周辺にて、大勢の女性が次々と倒れたようです！\n全員が昏:
A messenger!
A large number of women have collapsed one after another around the capital!
They are all in a coma, and the damage appears to be severe!
m920210.――助けてください！\n魔物に襲われています！:
Please… help me!
I'm being attacked by monsters!
m920210.……あなたの、目的は何？\nどうして、人々を眠らせるの？:
……What is your purpose?
Why are you putting people to sleep?
m920210.……パンプキンデウスたち、消えてしまいましたね。\nちゃんと、魔力の籠っていない:
……Pumpkin Deus and the others have vanished.
They left behind pumpkins that contain no mana.
m920210.『大切な人たちに危害を加えやがって』。\nあなたを討つには、そんな小規模な怒りで:
“You dared to harm the people we cherish.”
That small spark of anger is enough to defeat you.
m920210.あ、ああ……味のせいで目覚めた訳ではないんだな。\nだったらいいんだ、だったら…:
Ah, I see… it wasn't the taste that woke them up.
Well, that's fine, that's…
m920210.ああ、あいつは過去、十二回の敗北を喫している。\nその十二回とも、敵対した相手に:
Ah, yes. She suffered twelve defeats in the past.
And in all twelve, she left devastating destruction behind.
You'd do well to give up on the victims, for your own peace of mind.
m920210.ああ、あの女性を助けよう。\nただ、気を付けるべきは――。:
Yes, let's help that woman.
However, we must be careful about—
m920210.ああ、つい数日前に、偶然見かけてな。\nモーロンは貴様らに一度敗北したあと、\n: Yes. I happened to spot her a few days ago. After losing to you all, she apparently moved her base to a different forest.
m920210.ああ、やはり人間の心はうつくしい。\n私の葉と茎を焦がすその怒りさえ。:
Ah, human hearts truly are beautiful.
Even that anger which scorches my leaves and stems.
m920210.ああ、乾びる乾びる、その前に。\n私が、すべてのうつくしい心を押し花に変える！:
Ah, withering, withering, before that happens.
I will turn every beautiful heart into a pressed flower!
m920210.ああ、何度でも言ってやる！\nシャディア、お前の作るチョコは……まずい！:
Sure, I'll say it as many times as you like!
Shadia, your chocolate is… terrible!
m920210.ああ、分かった。\n急ごう皆、振り返らず走るぞ。:
Ah, I see.
Let's hurry. Run without looking back.
m920210.ああ、分かった。\n目指すはお菓子の街・移転地！\nいざ、眠れる女性たちを救う決: Understood. Our destination is the Candy Town relocation site! Let's go, to the decisive battle to save the sleeping women!
m920210.ああ、色が濃く実が詰まって、いいカボチャだ！\n植物に対する深い理解がなければ、:
Ah, look at that deep color and how plump they are!
Only someone with a profound understanding of plants could cultivate them like this.
m920210.ああ。チョコ騎士団長殿の命により、\n目下見廻り中なのだ。ただ、モテボーイ軍以上: I do. I'm on patrol by order of the Chocolate Knight Commander. But I don't think we have any more information than the Hot Boy Army.
m920210.あなたにとって、うつくしいものとはなんですか？\nうつくしいあなたの思う、うつく:
What is beautiful to you?
The beautiful thing that beautiful you believes in.
m920210.あら、腰が抜けてしまったのかしら？: Oh my, has your strength completely left you?
m920210.あれは――パンプキンデウス！？\n馬鹿な、奴は……ええと……。\nしばらく見てい:
That's—Pumpkin Deus!
Impossible, he's… um…
I haven't seen him in a while, so I thought he was dead…
m920210.あれは……チョコ騎士団と、シャディアさん？\nなんだか言い争ってるけど。:
Is that… the Chocolate Knights and Shadia?
They seem to be in a bit of a dispute.
m920210.うう～、身体はほかほか、空気はひえひえ。\n寒暖差で倒れそう……って、ほんとに誰:
Ugh~ My body is hot, but the air is freezing.
I might collapse from the temperature difference… Wait, is someone actually collapsing?
m920210.うつくしいですね。\n貴方と、仲間たち。その信頼と勇気は。:
You are so beautiful.
You and your companions. That trust and courage of yours.
m920210.うつくしい心が、枯れ果てる前に。\n奇麗なままで、揃えて並べて飾っていたいの。:
Before those beautiful hearts wither away.
I want to gather them, line them up, and display them
while they are still pristine.
m920210.うつくしくあろうとしないのは、うつくしくない。\n既に枯れた者は、私がこの手で…:
To refuse beauty is not beautiful.
Those who have already withered… I shall handle them with my own hands…
m920210.うつくしくなくなる、可能性。\nそれを打ち消すために、私は戦う！:
The possibility of them losing their beauty.
I fight to erase that possibility!
m920210.うぬの考え方は、我にはまるで分らぬが。\nそんなにカボチャが好きなら、置いていく:
I cannot fathom your way of thinking, Kabo…
If you love pumpkins so much, I'll leave these behind, Kabo…
m920210.うん、全部片付いたみたい。\nお姉さん、怪我はありませんか？:
Yes, it looks like we've dealt with everything.
Miss, are you hurt?
m920210.うん、悪い奴感出してくれると攻撃しやすくて助かるね。\nでも、この足音は……。:
Yeah, it'd help if you gave off a bit of a "bad guy" vibe so it's easier to attack you.
But, these footsteps are…
m920210.うん、昏睡していた人たちの意識は、戻らないまま。\nスィーテンも取り逃がして、な:
Yeah. The people who were in a coma still haven't regained consciousness.
And we let Suiten slip away… It really feels like we lost.
m920210.うん。だからそんな大規模なことを言っても、\n同じようなことを返してくれると思わ:
Yes. So don't expect us to respond
to such grandiose threats with the same kind of rhetoric.
m920210.ええ、人びとはすべて、かしに。\n街はあちらの、明るい色の道を駆けた先です。:
Yes, everyone is up in the sky.
The town is down that brightly lit path, just a short run away.
m920210.ええ、行きましょう。この悪夢を終わらせるために。: Yes, let's go. To end this nightmare.
m920210.ええ。誇らしい人たちです。\n……ところで、もう歩けるのですか？\nそれに、そっ:
Yes, they are truly admirable people.
…By the way, can you walk now?
Besides, that isn't the path everyone else took—
m920210.えっ……なんだそのコスい悪事……知らん……。: Huh... What a nasty thing to do... I didn't know.
m920210.えっ……？ ああごめんなさい、大切なことよね。\n皆、毒沼には気をつけて戦いまし:
Oh…? I'm sorry, that's very important.
Everyone, please be careful of the poison swamp!
m920210.おい王子、なにもこんな奴の話を！\n……いや、背に腹は代えられん。:
Hey, Prince, why are we listening to this woman!
...No, I suppose we have no choice.
m920210.お菓子に睡眠薬をたっぷり混ぜりゃ、\n眠らせられはするだろうが……あたしに何の得:
I suppose mixing a ton of sleeping pills into sweets
would put people to sleep, but... what's in it for me?
m920210.お菓子の街の住民みたいな見た目なのにね。\n……みて、あそこにモーロンがいる。: Even though they look just like the residents of Candy Town. ……Look, there's Mooron.
m920210.かくかくしかじかシュシュふわふわ。: So it went like this, and then this, and then that...
m920210.かし……菓子？\nそうだとしたら、お菓子の魔女たる\nモーロンのしわざに違いあり:
A treat… a pastry?
If that's the case, it must be the work of Moron,
the Witch of Sweets!
m920210.き、気付いていたっていうのかい！？\n近隣のちびっこ達に『交換こ』と称してガワだ:
Y-You knew about that?!
That I tricked the local kids into a "trade" with fake shells,
while I pocketed the real sweets for myself!
m920210.きっと、この辺りの毒沼のせいね。\n魔法のクッキーも、なんだか調子が悪そうにして:
It's probably the poison swamp around here.
Even my magic cookies seem a bit under the weather.
m920210.くうっ……ここは、撤退するカボ……。\n今年のバレンタインは、チョコに譲るカボ…:
Grrh… We shall withdraw from here, Kabo…
This year's Valentine's Day, we yield to chocolate, Kabo…
m920210.くっ……なんだあいつ、一人で盛り上がって！: Ugh… What's with her, getting all worked up on her own?
m920210.こいつらは、チョコからカカオを吸収し再生する！\nかつてない新時代の魔物さぁ！:
These guys absorb the cocoa from the chocolate and regenerate!
They're monsters of a brand-new era!
m920210.こういうのはどうせモーロンの仕業とは思うが、\n彼女の縄張りには、我々だけでは近: I figure this is Mooron's doing, but we can't get close to her territory on our own……
m920210.ここが、私たちの街です。\n皆が眠りについた、静かでうつくしい街。:
This is our town.
A quiet, beautiful town where everyone has fallen asleep.
m920210.こっちは冤罪かけられてんだ、このくらい当然さ。\nあたしとしても、あいつが伐たれ:
I've been framed, so this is the least I can do.
Besides, I'd be over the moon if she were put down.
m920210.こと薬学の深度に関しては、華の国に一日の長がある。\n私用のついでと称し、華王み:
When it comes to the depth of pharmacology, the Flower Country holds the edge.
The King of Flowers himself came to lend us some old medical texts, claiming it was a personal errand.
Given the recent incident, I suppose that's a fair assumption.
m920210.この毒の沼地は、人間には危険です。\n体力が削がれては勿体ないです。\n回復しな:
This poisonous swamp is dangerous for humans.
It would be a waste to have your stamina drained.
Please fight while healing yourselves. I beg you.
m920210.この濁ってるなりに曇りなき瞳……。\nまさか、本当に知らないのかしら。\nキャロ:
Those eyes are murky, but they're clear enough...
Could it be that she really doesn't know?
Calope, explain the situation to her.
m920210.これも、シャディアさんのチョコのお陰です。\nあの奇跡的な調合の発見が、特効薬の:
That's thanks to Shadia's chocolate.
The discovery of that miraculous recipe
greatly advanced the creation of a specific antidote.
m920210.さあ、眠らせた人たちの目を覚ます方法を教えなさい。: Now tell us how to wake the people you put to sleep.
m920210.さあ、行きましょう。眠れる乙女の目を覚まし、\nよきバレンタインを迎えるために！:
Now, let's go. We'll wake the sleeping maidens
and ensure a happy Valentine's Day!
m920210.せっかくだから、あれ言っちゃうね。\n『王子、ご指示をお願いします！』:
Since we're here, I might as well say it.
“Prince, please give us your orders!”
m920210.ぜェ、ぜェ……んぁア？\n眠らせるってなんだい。あたしゃ知らないよ。:
Phew... Phew... Huh?
Put to sleep? I have no idea what you're talking about.
m920210.そう……って、モーロンの居場所を知っているの！？: Wait…… you know where Mooron is?
m920210.そういう魔力は、魔物たちを引き付けるから厄介だよね。\nほら、辺りを気配が囲って:
That kind of magic tends to attract monsters, so it's a nuisance.
Look, the area is being surrounded by hostile presences.
m920210.そうはいくかい、こちらも新作を用意してんのさ！\n食べても食べても無くならないガ:
Not so fast, I've got a new trick up my sleeve!
Ever seen a chocolate cake that never runs out,
no matter how much you eat?
m920210.そこまでよ、お菓子の魔女！\n貴方の働いた悪事は、すべて把握しています！:
That's enough, you candy witch!
I know every last thing you've been up to.
m920210.それから、こうやって私を助けにきちゃう王子様とか。: And the Prince who comes rushing to my rescue like this.
m920210.それで昏睡させるだなんて、身勝手なひと。\nお生憎様、私たちは自分の意思で踊って:
To put them into a coma is so selfish.
I'm sorry, but we prefer to dance by our own will.
m920210.それに、美しくないとされた何かが、\nうっかり誰かを救ってしまうこともある。\n:
Besides, something deemed "not beautiful" might accidentally save someone's life.
Walking alongside all those possibilities is what the Kingdom's army is all about, right?
m920210.そんなに気を落とさないで。\n王国には、たくさんの協力者がいる。\nきっと誰かが:
Don't be so down.
The Kingdom has plenty of allies.
Someone out there will surely find a way to solve this.
m920210.たッ……大変だ！\nシャディアのまずいチョコを食べさせたら、\n昏睡していた女性:
It's… it's a miracle!
I made the woman in the coma eat Shadia's terrible chocolate, and she briefly regained consciousness!
m920210.だ、ダルク……！？\n貴方たしか、今日は街に行くって……。\nそれに、その腕の怪:
D-D'Arc…!?
You said you were going into the town today…
And that injury on your arm…
m920210.だが、いかにもな歯は厄介だな。\n即昏睡とはいかないだろうが、\n何度も噛まれれ:

But it does seem like Shadia's in the wrong…

Actually, it looks like they're sleeping!

We need to return to the castle immediately!

I can smell something strange…

Hehe, you're very good at that.

Come on, everyone, hang in there!

Well, I really am starting to toddle along.

Ma—wait!

Good morning, everyone!

The Knights of the Chocolate Body will guide you!

The Valentine's Festival is just around the corner,

I will show you a far more beautiful sight.

Kikikiki, I'm here too, Kabo!
Sown, grown, and greatly revived, a dreamy duet, Kabo~☆

Let's check it out in Charlotte's *Complete Guide to Mind Control*.

Sweeten... A witch of calamity on par with you or Mazu.

I thought they were showing us where Sweeten is?

There are signs of something strange happening in the Chocolate Marshlands,

Waltz, don't worry about it.

I don't want to see you again, so get going!
Eat your fill of sweets while you still can!

I am a good witch who loves humans.

We also received cooperation from the Garden of Wisdom, the World Tree,

The evacuation seems to be finished.
Now we can fight with all our might!

then add the cream just before it boils…

The sight of you walking together, united in strength… it is beautiful.
Ah, I must put them into a state of suspended animation, quickly.

The problem is how to prevent the next victim.
If only we could get a lead on the culprit…

I, the God of Pumpkins, shall be resurrected again and again, Kabo…

To protect our precious cacao,

Her form has changed… is that her true nature?
Everyone, the real fight starts now!

A hastily prepared stimulant failed to rouse them,
but the emergency response team is pooling all their resources to find a solution.

I'm afraid we are currently battling a far more powerful entity
who claims a similar grand cause.

??? : Redder than love, born of love.

The people who were under control are waking up smoothly.

A group of guys cornering a teary-eyed girl.

Beautiful things? Well…

but when battle starts, she gets foul-mouthed and her face gets scary!
m920227.最終戦のカードは、まあ大方の予想通りだな。: The card for the final round is, well, exactly what most people expected.
m920227.最近は、冒険者の数も増えてるって聞きますわよ？: I've heard that the number of adventurers has been increasing lately.
m920227.最高じゃねぇか！ やっぱそうでなくちゃなァ！: That's the spirit! This is exactly how it should be!
m920227.来ると分かってるもんに驚く理由もねぇよ。\n今回はお忙しいのか映像でのご登場だし:
There's no reason to be surprised when you know it's coming.
Looks like he's busy, so he's making a video appearance this time.
m920227.来ォい！ 相手になってやるぜぇッ！: Come on then! I'll be your match!
m920227.正しく『冒険』をする余裕ができてきたってことか、\n良い世の中になったもんじゃね:
So people finally have the leisure to go on "adventures" in the true sense.
Things really are getting better.
m920227.正直なのはとてもいいことですねー。\n何かあったらすぐに相談してください。:
Honesty is a wonderful quality.
If anything comes up, please don't hesitate to talk to me.
m920227.然り、これ以上は命のやり取りになりましょう。: Indeed. Going any further would mean risking our lives.
m920227.物質界の治安は全体的に上昇傾向にあるので、\n討伐系の依頼が減ったのが大きそうで:
Since public safety in the Material World has been improving overall,
the drop in subjugation requests is likely a major factor.
m920227.盾を以って目前の困難を打ち砕く──\nつまりは広義のシールドバッシュね！:
To shatter the difficulties before you with a shield—
that is, in the broadest sense, a shield bash!
m920227.盾使いのことシールドバッシャーって言うのお前だけだよ。: You're the only one who calls shield users "shield bashers."
m920227.私たちに足りないものは実戦経験、\n焦ってどうにかなるものではありません。\nゆ: What we lack is practical combat experience. It's not something that can be fixed in a rush. We just need to learn at our own pace.
m920227.第二試合の会場はここになります。: This is the venue for the second match.
m920227.自由を愛する者たちよ！ 誇りに生きる者たちよ！\n勇を携え野原に立ち、未知を既知:
Those who love freedom! Those who live with pride!
Those who stand in the fields with courage, turning the unknown into the known!
If you wish to grasp glory yet unseen, gather beneath my banner!
m920227.若き幻術士よ、すでに勝負はついた。\nそれ以上は無用な禍根を残すことになる。\n:
Young illusionist, the match is already decided.
Going any further would only leave unnecessary scars.
You have no objections, Flower of the Void?
m920227.行くぜ王国！ 成長した俺たちの力を見せてやらァ！: Here we come, Kingdom! Let's show you the power of who we've become!
m920227.街を守るための戦いがあった。\n村落を守る戦いもあったはずだ。:
There were battles fought to defend cities.
And surely, others to protect humble villages.
m920227.見知った顔も多いですが、新顔もかなり多いですね。: I recognize quite a few faces, but there are a lot of newcomers too.
m920227.馬車を守る戦いだったかもしれん、\n畑を守る戦いだったかもしれん。:
Perhaps it was a battle to save a single carriage.
Or maybe, to defend a patch of farmland.
m920227.馬鹿で上等！ 自由に生きてこその冒険者だぜ！: Being an idiot is fine! Living freely is what makes us adventurers!
m920227.馬鹿は馬鹿でも、馬鹿をやり通す実力がある。\nマレスの野郎もそうだが、そういうや:
Stupid, sure, but she has the skill to pull it off.
That Mares guy is the same way. Those kinds of people are strong, you know?
m920227.馬鹿ばっかです？: You guys are all such idiots.
m920227.魔王の復活から、天界との決戦まで。\nこれまでにお前たち冒険者は一度は必ず、\n:
From the Demon King's revival to the decisive battle with the Celestial Realm.
Up until now, you adventurers have surely all fought
to protect something at least once.
m920227.（……チェルシーは昔から自身を過小評価しがちでした）: (……Chelsea has always tended to underestimate herself.)
m920227.（これが娘が嫁に行く親の気持ちなのでしょうか。\nであれば、嫁ぎ先への八つ当たり:
(Is this how a parent feels when their daughter marries?
If so, taking it out on the groom is a natural right──)
m920227.（それは私を筆頭に『虚空の花』という、\n各分野の天才たちに囲まれて育ったゆえの:
(It is a bad habit born from growing up surrounded by the geniuses
of the “Flowers of the Void,” myself included……)
m920227.（ちょっと王国、倒しちゃいます？）: (Shall I just go ahead and take down the Kingdom?)
m920227.（やっぱり私じゃ師匠に及ばない……！\n地力も、経験も、幻術の精度も天と地！）:
(I still can't compare to Master……!
In raw power, experience, and even the precision of her illusions, it's like day and night!)
m920227.（ソードマスターさんが無言で帰っていくのです……）: (The Swordmaster is leaving without a word...)
m920227.（最愛の弟子が自分の手を離れていくというのは、\n嬉しくもありますが同時に、中々:
(Watching my dearest disciple drift away from my side……
it brings me joy, but it is also rather lonely.)
m920227.（私、ここでやっていけるかなぁ……）: (Do I really have what it takes to keep up here……?)
m920227.（私もいつか、あんな風になれるのかな？）: (Can I ever become someone like that one day?)
m920227.（自分は凡人であるという思い込みは根深く、\n私たちの誰かが諭したところで効果は:
(Her belief that she is merely ordinary is deeply rooted,
and no amount of advice from us will change it.
I was right to judge that drastic measures were needed, but……)
m920227.（見えなかった、動けなかった、それは構わない。\n実力が足りないのなら努力して強:
(I couldn't see, I couldn't move. That's fine.
If I lack the skill, I'll just work harder to get stronger.)
